browser.scope: full Chromium suite, including Material 3 Expressive spatial/effects entry, reversal and exit, spatially overshooting reveals, inert logical close, focus restoration, rapid discarded-draft reopening, reduced motion, explicit model-test abort, palette/model/search/canvas-menu regressions, annotations, resizing and real PNG/PDF downloads

screenshots.inspection: All 150 captures inspected through six desktop/mobile contact sheets; the canvas export was inspected at full resolution. Motion captures show the expressive spatial/effects split: panel entry, closing and mobile entry reported three running animations, the toolbar reveal and canvas menu two, and reduced motion zero. The closing panel midpoint measured opacity 0.086 under the effects curve, the opening canvas menu 0.943, and the toolbar exceeded its settled width at midpoint to confirm spatial overshoot. Menu targets, focus rings, viewport bounds and clipped exiting panels remained correct.
